body_en:
You can send in almost any type of message for entry in OUTBOARD in any format: a DATA statement, Tasword file, handwritten letter etc. "Ideally", it should not be larger than 10 screen lines. Your message will be published, free of charge, monthly until: 1. You request its removal; 2. It gets "crowded off" by newer messages (when you may apply again for it to be re-entered); 3. We consider it to have fulfilled its purpose (e.g. "Club meeting on the 6th").
